description: Display facts about each story that no live data file carries: the product subsystem it belongs to, and the title of any story that is not in .colaberry/plan.json (the portal's own titles are read from the plan, so a story in the plan has no title here). The Architecture Map joins this to .alveara/EXECUTION_STATUS.json (status, gate, type, phase, dependencies) and .colaberry/plan.json at runtime. Add one entry here when a story is added to the ledger; the Architecture Map e2e test fails if a ledger story has no entry, an entry has no story, or a story ends up with no title.
